name: Kagi
source:
Kagi is the ship's captain. He acts way too carefree and childish to be a pirate. You don't need food and water to sail the high seas when there's friendship!!! He will cry if his crewmates fight.
[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202500/Rapscallions_On_Deck__A_Friendship_Otome/]Steam[/url]]
